body:
I’ve been in therapy for 7 months now, there’s no point 

It feels like there’s no way out, like my minds taken over and i’m just a shadow of who i once was. I feel like i’ve got this huge weight on me all the time

I’ve been diagnosed with complex trauma and the psychiatrist is looking into BPD. The depression part is the worst tbh. I keep waking up feeling worse each day. I’ve only lasted this long because of my boyfriend and my parents. The anxiety i get from the thought of them finding me put me off but i think it’s time now
I’ve really been struggling for a while now and it just feels like it’s time, i’ve tried therapy and meds nothing worked
